title: Kagamine Len — Shyly Greeting While Hiding〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: What Lies Beyond Guiding a Lost Child

rows.Line: Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Len, is something bothering you...?
You seem a little down...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh? N-No... I don't feel sad or anything...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Really...? Are by chance feeling nervous...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Why would he be nervous? It's his welcoming party.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (They really don't have to go out of their way to throw me a welcoming party...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: He's hiding behind Miku again...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's okay♪ We'll be chatting like old friends in no time once we get to know each other better.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And we're throwing you this welcoming party for that very purpose.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Where's Mafuyu...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It's gonna be pretty tight, but she said she'll drop by later.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I see...
Mafuyu's coming too, Len.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, let's finish setting everything up before Mafuyu gets here!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay, we need to lay out the tarp first. Mind giving me a hand, everyone?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, you used this tarp when you went to see those cherry blossoms. You're using it again for this...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
It's kinda what a tarp's for.
Also, Miku said she wanted to do something similar for this.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Miku, you asked them for this?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We'll have Len with us moving forward, but he probably doesn't know much about what we've been doing until now...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So, he may have an easier time talking to us if we told him about those things... At least, that's what MEIKO said...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh...? MEIKO, this was your idea...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: All I suggested was that if you want to understand what somebody's like, you should probably learn more about them first...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: To be fair, we've been through a lot together, so it's gonna take more than a day to talk about everything...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I mean, we can always tell him during another visit.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Everything you've done until now...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. Although, you may not find it all interesting...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But we'd like to tell you as much as we can if it means you'll feel more comfortable around us.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay, thank you...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Anyway, once the tarp's all laid out, let's start getting the snacks and drinks ready!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Rin, Miku, I'll open the bags, so would you mind emptying them onto these paper plates?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Fine...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, Kanade, what should we do...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Um... Let's see...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. If you don't decide fast, I'll have no choice but start trying all these snacks.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: What?! Wait...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I think her job can be to sit still quietly...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Is it me or do they seem kind of excited...?)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Could it be that they've been looking forward to throwing me a welcoming party...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, which bag was the paper cups in?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: U-Um...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hm? What's up, Len?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Uh... Is there anything I can help out with...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh? But you're the star of today's show, so it's totally okay for you to just sit back and enjoy...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Alright, you can help me out♪
Mind looking for the paper cups with me?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
...!
Okay, got it.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Huh...? What is this...?)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
(The party hasn't even begun yet...
But this part of me feels kind of warm...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
(Oh, that must be it...
I'm excited about this too.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Sorry for being late...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Nice timing♪
We were just pouring drinks and getting ready to say, “Cheers!”

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Mafuyu's here too...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Okay, I think we're all set.
Take it away, Miku♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Len, thank you for coming to SEKAI.
We're looking forward to getting to know you better.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Th-Thanks...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So... Cheers.

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Cheers.
Cheers!
